name: Kav
description: Sapient Kavu-folk of the Edge, native to Kavaron.

description_citations.text: "Kavu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle, drawn by the Kav's furious emigration, comes to Sothera, builds the eternity column Infinite Guideline and opens the system to the Edge.
timeline.quote: We came to Sothera, constructed an FTL outpost—an eternity column designated Infinite Guideline —and opened the system to the rest of the connected Edge.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav begin an exodus from Kavaron after centuries of mining that destabilized their world.
timeline.quote: Decades have passed since Exodus Day, when the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: On the fifth day Kadrik finds a Kav stasis pod camouflaged on the tundra.
timeline.quote: I nearly miss the stasis pod

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz says he is from Pinnacle's programming division and was captured by the Kav.
timeline.quote: We were on a team-building exercise when the Kav took us captive.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz warns that the Kav are biding their time with a new warship.
timeline.quote: We were taken by a brand-new warship and held on a station retrofitted for battle.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Driven by the coming supernova, the Kav's mining collapses Kavaron, which crumbles into space during the Ruin.
timeline.quote: The planet finally crumbled after centuries of Kav industrial strip mining

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "The Ruin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Exodus Day the first Kav shuttle lifts the first refugees off Kavaron.
timeline.quote: the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "The Ruin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: the Kavaronic Empire plans to invade Evendo once terraformed
relations.quote: who are already designing invasion plans to take the world for their own once the Eumidians have finished remaking it

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: The native people of Kavaron who tore open their world and evolved beneath the star-blood sky.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.
